# GrantRevokeScope

`schemas/api/scope/grant-revoke.json`

The scope of grant.revoke (docs/design/m0/04 "Grants"): the live grant to revoke, at once. The pending proposals made under it are invalidated (authority_revoked) and the streams read under it close in the same fold. Only an operator revokes a grant.

No other fields are allowed.
